learning_outcomes.text: Convert theoretical knowledge into practice through laboratory and project work
Gain the ability to work individually and in a team
Formulate a knowledge base on fundamental topics related to Electrical-Electronics Engineering
Gain the ability and skill to analyze and design systems

syllabus_topics: Introduction to laboratory measurement devices and experiment sheets, and group formation.
Period, Frequency and Voltage Measurement with Oscilloscope.
RC Circuit Analysis under Alternating Current.
RL Circuit Analysis under Alternating Current.
RLC Circuit Analysis under Alternating Current.
Power Measurement in Alternating Current Circuit.
Power analysis in ohmic circuit and RL circuit.
Make up experiments for excused students
Make up experiments for excused students
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course schedule. Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate decision and specified in the academic calendar.
